name: Karol
backstory: Cashguard Basher Karol, is a human member of the Cashguard located in The Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. She can be found on the second floor, guarding the door to Rakath Glitterbeard's office alongside Cashguard Artillerist Faona.
